messages:
karina: publish blocked — regen-diff non-empty after a typegen bump; sample-app auth tests flaked. cc @oliver

oliver: paste the CI snippet?

karina: ci-bot: [build 7340] nodejs-sdk/regendiff-check failed

karina: ```diff
--- a/src/options.ts
+++ b/src/options.ts
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
-  authRetry?: boolean;
+  retries?: number;
```

dena: yep that's the boolean->number change. also note ordering diffs between mac/arm dev runs and linux/x64 CI causing regen noise.

oliver: short-term: pin @redwood/typegen to 3.1.x in SDKs and push hotfix to unblock. long-term: add two checks — run typegen in linux-x64 CI container before publish and a heuristic that flags renames/type-changes for fields matching words: retry/backoff/auth/timeout.

devx-bot: suggested heuristic: compare previous published types and if field name or type differs AND name matches keyword list, require changelog entry + owner sign-off.

karina: filed devex#523: "typegen: linux-x64 regen + heuristic detect auth/retry shape changes" with repro steps and logs. hotfix branch created: samplekit/pin-typegen-3.1.

oliver: also soften sample-app tests to avoid asserting internal backoff timing; assert observable retries instead. small PR incoming.

ci-bot: rebuild queued: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/7341 :rocket:

karina: will update the release playbook to include running typegen in the linux-x64 container and to require changelog note for semantic changes. merging hotfix after CI green. :white_check_mark:
